cases.title: Student logs in with valid credentials and lands on the Student dashboard
cases.pre: Seeded account student01 exists and is active
cases.steps: 1. Open /accounts/login/ 2. Enter username and password 3. Click Log in
cases.expected: Login succeeds; Student dashboard 'Welcome, Student 01' with My room, Fees and Complaints cards
cases.actual: Redirected to / with heading 'Welcome, Student 01'; cards shown: My room, Fees, Complaints

cases.title: Login with a wrong password is refused
cases.steps: 1. Open /accounts/login/ 2. Enter student01 with a wrong password 3. Click Log in
cases.expected: Stays on the login page with an error message; no session is created
cases.actual: Stayed on /accounts/login/; message: 'Please enter a correct username and password. Note that both fields may be case-sensitive.'; /fees/my/ still redirects to login

cases.title: Each staff role lands on the right dashboard; Technician is kept out of admin pages
cases.pre: Seeded admin, warden; tech01 created by setup_st_data.py
cases.steps: 1. Log in as admin, read the dashboard heading 2. Repeat as warden 3. Log in as tech01 and open /reports/, /allocation/rooms/ and /complaints/queue/
cases.expected: Admin and Warden see 'Warden / Admin dashboard'; Technician gets 403 on reports and rooms and 200 on the complaint queue
cases.actual: admin: 'Warden / Admin dashboard'; warden: 'Warden / Admin dashboard'; tech01 HTTP codes: {'/reports/': 403, '/allocation/rooms/': 403, '/complaints/queue/': 200}

cases.title: Student cannot open Warden/Admin pages (vertical escalation)
cases.steps: 1. Log in as student01 2. Type each Admin/Warden URL into the address bar
cases.expected: Every URL returns HTTP 403 Forbidden
cases.actual: All 8 URLs returned 403

cases.title: Student updates own profile
cases.steps: 1. Open My profile 2. Change phone and address 3. Click Save 4. Reload the page
cases.data: Phone: 9123456780, Address: Room A103, PES Hostel, Bengaluru
cases.expected: 'Your profile was updated successfully.' shown; new values still there after reload
cases.actual: Message 'Your profile was updated successfully.'; after reload phone=9123456780, address='Room A103, PES Hostel, Bengaluru'

cases.title: Password reset with emailed OTP; OTP is single use
cases.pre: student05 has a registered email; email delivery captured to files (stands in for MailHog)
cases.steps: 1. Open Forgot password, enter email 2. Read the OTP from the email 3. Enter email, OTP and new password twice 4. Log in with the new password 5. Try the same OTP again 6. Try the old password
cases.expected: OTP email received; reset succeeds; login works with new password; reused OTP refused; old password refused
cases.actual: OTP 033464 emailed; reset done and new password logs in; reusing the OTP shows 'Invalid or expired OTP. Request a new one and try again.' and the password is unchanged; old password refused

cases.title: Session expires 20 minutes after the last request; logout ends it
cases.steps: 1. Log in 2. Inspect the session cookie expiry 3. Open a page and inspect again 4. Click Log out 5. Open /fees/my/
cases.expected: Session cookie expires 20 min after each request (sliding); after logout the fee page redirects to login
cases.actual: Cookie TTL 1200s after login and 1200s after a later request (refreshed); HttpOnly; after logout /fees/my/ redirects to /accounts/login/?next=/fees/my/

cases.title: Student views own room and roommates
cases.pre: student01 and student04 allocated to A103 (setup_st_data.py)
cases.steps: 1. Log in as student01 2. Open My room
cases.expected: Block A, Room A103, Shared, roommate 'Demo Student 04'
cases.actual: Shows 'Block A · Room A103', type Shared, roommate Demo Student 04

cases.title: Admin allocates a room; occupancy updates
cases.pre: Logged in as admin; student02 has no room; A104 empty
cases.steps: 1. Open Allocate room 2. Choose student and room 3. Click Allocate 4. Open Rooms
cases.data: Student: Demo Student 02, Room: Block A Room A104
cases.expected: 'Room A104 in Block A successfully allocated to Demo Student 02.'; A104 occupancy 1 of 2
cases.actual: Message 'Room A104 in Block A successfully allocated to Demo Student 02.'; room list row: Block A A104 1 Shared 2 1 / 2 Active Edit Deactivate

cases.title: Allocation that breaks the block gender policy is refused
cases.pre: Logged in as admin; Block B is Female only
cases.steps: 1. Open Allocate room 2. Choose a male student and a Block B room 3. Click Allocate
cases.data: Student: Demo Student 05 [M], Room: Block B Room B102
cases.expected: 'This block is not available for this student.'; no allocation made
cases.actual: Refused with 'This block is not available for this student.'; still on the allocate page

cases.title: Two admins race for the last bed; the second is refused
cases.pre: Logged in as admin; single room A101 (capacity 1) is empty
cases.steps: 1. Admin opens Allocate room and selects student05 + A101 2. Before submitting, a second admin session allocates student02 to A101 3. First admin clicks Allocate 4. Open Rooms
cases.data: Room A101 (Single, capacity 1); students Demo Student 05 and Demo Student 02
cases.expected: Second allocation refused with a clear error; A101 shows occupancy 1 of 1, never 2
cases.actual: Second submit refused: 'Select a valid choice. That choice is not one of the available choices.'. Room list: Block A A101 1 Single 1 1 / 1 Active Edit Deactivate. A101 no longer offered in the room list

cases.title: Admin creates, edits and deactivates student records; new student sets a password by OTP and logs in
cases.steps: 1. Add Student with the data shown 2. Search by roll number 3. Edit phone 4. New student uses Forgot password to set a password and logs in 5. Admin deactivates student10 6. student10 tries to log in
cases.data: Roll: ST2026001, Email: st.newstudent@demo.hms.test, Name: System Test Student, Gender: M, Phone (edit): 9988776655
cases.expected: Record created and listed; edit saved; new student logs in to the Student dashboard; deactivated student10 is hidden from the list and cannot log in
cases.actual: 'Student record created for System Test Student (ST2026001).'; edit: 'Student record for System Test Student updated successfully.'; new student set a password by OTP and saw 'Welcome, ST2026001'; 'Student DEMO2026010 has been deactivated.'; student10 hidden from the list and login refused

cases.title: Admin creates a block and a room; invalid rooms are refused
cases.steps: 1. Add Block 2. Add Room in the new block 3. Add the same room number again 4. Add a room with capacity 0
cases.data: Block C (Male); Room C201, floor 2, Shared, capacity 2; duplicate C201; C202 with capacity 0
cases.expected: Block and room created with success messages; duplicate refused with 'A room with this number already exists in this block.'; capacity 0 refused
cases.actual: 'Block 'Block C' created successfully.'; 'Room C201 created successfully.'; duplicate: 'A room with this number already exists in this block.'; capacity 0: 'Capacity must be at least 1.'

cases.title: Admin deactivates a room; it is no longer offered for allocation
cases.pre: Room C201 exists and is empty (ST_20)
cases.steps: 1. Open Rooms 2. Click Deactivate on C201 and confirm 3. Open Allocate room
cases.expected: 'Room C201 has been deactivated.'; C201 missing from the room choices
cases.actual: 'Room C201 has been deactivated.'; C201 not in the allocate form's room list

cases.title: Student requests a room change; Warden approves it
cases.steps: 1. student01 opens Request Room Change, picks A105, gives a reason, submits 2. Warden opens the room-change queue and clicks Approve 3. student01 opens My room
cases.data: Preferred room: Block A Room A105, Reason: Closer to the study hall
cases.expected: Request shown as Pending; Warden sees 'Room change request #n has been approved.'; student01 now in A105
cases.actual: Student: 'Room change request submitted successfully.' (Pending). Warden: 'Room change request #1 has been approved.'. My room now shows Room A105

cases.title: Warden rejects a room-change request; allocation unchanged
cases.steps: 1. student04 requests A104 2. Warden clicks Reject 3. student04 opens My room and the request page
cases.data: Preferred room: Block A Room A104, Reason: Quieter floor
cases.expected: 'Room change request #n has been rejected.'; student04 still in A103; request shows Rejected
cases.actual: Warden: 'Room change request #2 has been rejected.'. student04 still in Room A103; request listed as Rejected

cases.title: Student views an itemised fee statement
cases.pre: student01 allocated (shared room); 2026-ODD fee structure seeded
cases.steps: 1. Log in as student01 2. Open Fees
cases.expected: Row for 2026-ODD 'Hostel fee (Shared)' with amount due, amount paid 0, balance = due - paid, due date
cases.actual: Term 2026-ODD, Hostel fee (Shared), due 65000.00, paid 0.00, balance 65000.00, due date Dec. 16, 2026

cases.title: A failed gateway payment leaves the balance unchanged
cases.steps: 1. Fees > Pay now 2. On the sandbox checkout click 'Fail (test)' 3. Return to Fees
cases.expected: Balance and amount paid unchanged; no receipt can be downloaded for the failed attempt
cases.actual: Balance stayed 65000.00, paid stayed 0.00; no 'Download receipt' link offered for the failed attempt

cases.title: Student pays the fee through the sandbox gateway
cases.steps: 1. Fees > Pay now 2. On the sandbox checkout click 'Pay (test)' (signed webhook returns to HMS) 3. Return to Fees
cases.data: Mock gateway outcome: SUCCESS for the full balance
cases.expected: Checkout page has no card fields; amount paid = amount due; balance 0.00
cases.actual: Checkout had 0 card inputs; after the signed webhook: paid 65000.00, balance 0.00

cases.title: Student downloads the PDF receipt; another student cannot
cases.steps: 1. Fees > Download receipt for the paid attempt 2. Log in as student02 and open the same receipt URL
cases.data: Receipt URL of student01's successful payment
cases.expected: student01 gets a PDF file; student02 gets 404 (no information leak)
cases.actual: /fees/payments/2/receipt/ returned application/pdf (1867 bytes, starts with %PDF); student02 on the same URL: HTTP 404

cases.title: Warden configures fee structures; invalid entries refused; existing statements keep their amount
cases.pre: Logged in as warden; student03 already has a 2026-ODD statement
cases.steps: 1. Note student03's amount due 2. New fee structure for 2026-EVEN 3. Try a duplicate 2026-ODD Shared 4. Try amount 0 5. Edit 2026-ODD Shared amount +1000 6. student03 re-opens Fees
cases.data: 2026-EVEN / Single / 52000 / due 2027-03-31 / from 2027-01-01; duplicate 2026-ODD Shared; amount 0
cases.expected: 'Fee structure created.'; duplicate and zero amount refused with errors; 'Fee structure updated.'; student03's amount due unchanged
cases.actual: 'Fee structure created.'; duplicate refused: 'Fee structure with this Term and Room type already exists.'; amount 0 refused: 'Constraint “fees_structure_amount_positive” is violated.'; 'Fee structure updated.' (65000.00 -> 66000.00); student03 amount due stayed 65000.00

cases.title: Admin reconciles payments against the gateway ledger and sees defaulters
cases.steps: 1. Log in as admin 2. Open Reconciliation for this month
cases.expected: Matched payments >= 1, no mismatches; Defaulters table lists DEMO2026003
cases.actual: 'Matched payments: 1'; Defaulters table includes DEMO2026003 (student03)

cases.title: Student raises a maintenance complaint with a photo
cases.steps: 1. Complaints > New 2. Choose category, type description, attach photo 3. Submit 4. Open My complaints
cases.data: Category: Plumbing, Description: Bathroom tap in A105 is leaking, Photo: tap.png (valid 1x1 PNG)
cases.expected: 'Complaint CMP-nnnnnn raised. Status: Open.' with a new ticket id; ticket listed as Open
cases.actual: 'Complaint CMP-000001 raised. Status: Open.'; My complaints row: CMP-000001 Plumbing Bathroom tap in A105 is leaking Open 16 Nov 2026, 09:06

cases.title: Unsafe complaint attachments are refused
cases.steps: 1. Complaints > New 2. Attach each bad file 3. Submit
cases.data: notes.png (text file renamed to .png); run.exe; photo.gif
cases.expected: Each upload refused with 'This file type or size is not allowed. Use a JPG or PNG image of 5 MB or less.'
cases.actual: notes.png: refused; run.exe: refused; photo.gif: refused (message: 'This file type or size is not allowed...')

cases.title: Another student cannot open a complaint or its photo (IDOR)
cases.pre: Ticket from ST_13 belongs to student01
cases.steps: 1. Log in as student02 2. Open /complaints/<ticket>/ and /complaints/<ticket>/photo/
cases.expected: Both return 404 Not Found
cases.actual: /complaints/CMP-000001/ -> 404, /complaints/CMP-000001/photo/ -> 404

cases.title: Warden moves a complaint Open -> In Progress -> Resolved; student is notified
cases.steps: 1. Warden opens the complaint queue 2. Click Mark In Progress 3. Click Mark Resolved 4. student01 opens the ticket
cases.expected: Each change shows '<ticket> updated. The student has been notified.'; ticket shows Resolved with a timestamped timeline Open, In Progress, Resolved; one email per change
cases.actual: Messages: ['CMP-000001 updated. The student has been notified.', 'CMP-000001 updated. The student has been notified.']; 2 notification emails; timeline: ['Open · 16 Nov 2026, 09:06', 'In Progress · 16 Nov 2026, 09:06', 'Resolved · 16 Nov 2026, 09:06']

cases.title: A resolved complaint cannot go back to Open
cases.steps: 1. Warden opens the queue: no buttons for the resolved ticket 2. Warden submits status=OPEN for the ticket directly (forged form post)
cases.expected: No transition buttons offered; forged request refused with 'This status change is not allowed.'
cases.actual: 0 transition buttons on the resolved ticket; forged post answered 'This status change is not allowed.'

cases.title: Admin generates occupancy, vacancy and fee-collection reports
cases.pre: Allocations and one successful payment exist
cases.steps: 1. Reports 2. For each report type pick this month's range and click Generate
cases.data: Types: occupancy, vacancy, fee collection; 2026-11-01 to 2026-11-16
cases.expected: Each report renders a titled table; the vacancy report does not list the full room A101; fee collection includes student01's 65000 payment
cases.actual: occupancy: 'Occupancy by block', 2 rows; vacancy: 'Vacant beds by room', 9 rows; fee-collection: 'Fee collection', 1 rows; defaulters: 'Fee defaulters', 1 rows; A101 absent from vacancy; fee collection shows the 65000 payment

cases.title: Report exports as CSV and PDF match the screen
cases.steps: 1. Click Export CSV 2. Click Export PDF 3. Compare with the on-screen table
cases.expected: CSV rows equal the on-screen rows cell for cell; PDF downloads and opens
cases.actual: CSV header ['Block', 'Rooms', 'Beds', 'Occupied', 'Vacant', 'Occupancy %'] and all 2 data rows equal the on-screen table cell for cell; PDF 2143 bytes, application/pdf

cases.title: Report with an end date before the start date is refused
cases.steps: 1. Reports 2. Set From after To 3. Generate
cases.expected: 'The start date must be on or before the end date.'; no table shown
cases.actual: HTTP 400; message 'The start date must be on or before the end date.'; no report table

cases.title: Admin actions from this run appear in the read-only audit log
cases.pre: ST_07, ST_08, ST_10, ST_14, ST_24 executed
cases.steps: 1. Log in as admin 2. Open Django admin > Audit logs 3. Look for the actions from this run 4. Look for Add / Delete controls
cases.expected: Entries for allocation, room-change approval, payment, complaint status and fee-structure edits, each with actor and timestamp; no Add or Delete control
cases.actual: 21 audit logs listed with actor and time, including allocation, room change, payment, complaint status, fee structure actions; no Add button (0) and no delete action

cases.title: A form post without a CSRF token is refused
cases.steps: 1. Send POST /accounts/profile/ with the session cookie but no CSRF token
cases.expected: HTTP 403; profile unchanged
cases.actual: HTTP 403; phone still 9123456780

cases.title: Student pages fit a 360 px phone screen (partial check)
cases.steps: 1. Set the browser to 360 x 740 2. Open dashboard, My room, Fees, New complaint 3. Measure page width
cases.expected: No page wider than the viewport (no sideways scrolling); menu collapses to a toggle button
cases.actual: scrollWidth per page: {'/': 360, '/allocation/my-room/': 360, '/fees/my/': 360, '/complaints/new/': 360}; navbar toggle visible: True
